verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for an identity-verification and fraud SaaS like Alloy, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data-residency controls. The only storage-related item says Sandbox and Production records share a single data store for the account, which describes environment separation, not geographic residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
